description: Defines the interface for a V4L2 video decoder backend in Chromium, including classes, methods, and callbacks related to hardware-accelerated video decoding on Linux/ChromeOS.

classes.name: V4L2VideoDecoderBackend
classes.description: Abstract class managing low-level V4L2 decoding tasks, including buffer processing, resolution changes, and error handling.

classes.name: V4L2VideoDecoderBackend::Client
classes.description: Interface for callback methods from the backend to the decoder, including error reporting, flush control, stream management, and output.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: EnqueueDecodeTask
methods.description: Schedules a buffer for decoding with a specified bitstream ID.

methods.name: OnOutputBufferDequeued
methods.description: Called when a decoded buffer is dequeued from the capture queue.

methods.name: OnServiceDeviceTask
methods.description: Optional method for backend-specific device task processing.

methods.name: OnStreamStopped
methods.description: Handles stream stop events, indicating whether the input queue was stopped.

methods.name: ApplyResolution
methods.description: Applies a new resolution to the backend, returning success status.

methods.name: OnChangeResolutionDone
methods.description: Callback when resolution change completes, with status.

methods.name: ClearPendingRequests
methods.description: Clears all pending decode requests with a given status.

methods.name: StopInputQueueOnResChange
methods.description: Indicates if the input queue should be stopped during resolution change.

methods.name: GetNumOUTPUTQueueBuffers
methods.description: Returns the number of output queue buffers needed.
